categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Jetsen Technology Co., Ltd operates primarily in four segments: audio-video technology, film and television content production and distribution, new media copyright operation, and digital marketing services. The core business focuses on new media copyright operation and distribution, integrating copyright procurement, digital distribution, and content operation. The company also actively develops AI-driven content creation and short video/micro-drama businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies, especially AIGC (AI-generated content), including its proprietary AI intelligent creation engine ChatPV, which supports multi-modal content generation such as text, audio, video, and digital humans. It employs digital distribution platforms and multi-channel, multi-scenario, multi-mode, and multi-year copyright monetization strategies. The production methods include digital content integration, AI-assisted video editing, and multi-language translation technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include broadcasters, internet video platforms, telecom operators, and digital TV/IPTV/OTT platforms. The company serves domestic and international markets, including over 200 countries and regions, with clients such as Youku, iQIYI, Tencent Video, Huawei Video, and short video platforms like Douyin and Kuaishou. It also targets children's entertainment, education, and overseas distribution markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant presence in regions such as North China, Central China, East China, South China, Northeast, Southwest, and Northwest China. It also has overseas operations and content distribution in over 200 countries, including Russia, Kazakhstan, and the Middle East, and maintains active channels on global platforms like YouTube and Facebook.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jetsen operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital content supply chain, focusing on copyright procurement, digital distribution, content operation, and marketing services. It acts as a digital copyright distributor and full-media cultural communication service provider, integrating upstream content acquisition with downstream multi-platform distribution and monetization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on a 'one body, two wings' development model: resource-based copyright business as the core, with AI-generated content (AIGC) and copyright innovation as the two wings. It emphasizes R&D in AI technologies for content creation, multi-modal AI models, intelligent translation, automated editing, and digital marketing. The company also invests in short video and micro-drama content production and global content distribution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through licensing and distribution of digital copyrights, content production and sales, digital marketing services, and AI-powered content creation tools. The company employs multi-channel monetization including direct sales, revenue sharing agreements, advertising income, subscription fees, and digital marketing service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jetsen is positioned as a leading domestic digital copyright distributor and full-media cultural communication service provider in China. It holds a market-leading position in terms of copyright volume and quality, brand influence, and distribution channels. The company collaborates with over a thousand content producers and maintains strong partnerships with major internet and broadcasting platforms, establishing significant competitive barriers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jetsen reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.87 billion, a 2.36% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 238 million, a decline of 47%. Total assets reached RMB 11.18 billion, growing 5.08% year-over-year. The company increased R&D investment significantly, especially in AI technologies, and expanded its digital marketing and short video businesses, aiming for sustainable growth despite profit fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jetsen’s value proposition lies in its extensive and high-quality copyright library exceeding 100,000 hours of film, animation, and program content, combined with advanced AI-driven content creation and distribution capabilities. Its integrated digital copyright supply chain platform offers multi-screen, multi-modal, and multi-scenario content distribution, enhanced by AI technologies that improve production efficiency and content innovation. The company’s global distribution network and strong brand reputation further differentiate it in the competitive media industry.
